propositions: Janitor discovery concern #12 must evaluate whether test assertions can actually fail when a contract is violated, identifying oracle-strength gaps and contract-coverage misses via concrete escape-input proofs
The durable oracle test must derive concern counts from both the numbered list and schema sentence, failing CI if they diverge, preventing silent disagreement between two halves of the same artifact

The portable fallback in references/patterns.md must include the oracle-strength question, mandatory escape-input proof shape, false-positive floor rule, three new antipattern ids, and a runnable query, so janitor runs against repos lacking the code-review-tests.md rubric
Test-only findings must anchor their prod_impact on the guarded production contract, not the file path, and require tree-state demonstration or escape-input reasoning to prove harm reachable
The SKILL.md description must name oracle strength among discovery topics within the 1024-character cap, and test_janitor_concern_schema.py must demonstrate the durable oracle can fail under mutation
